# pve_container_snapshot (Data Source)

Reads one snapshot of an LXC container (`GET /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/snapshot/{snapname}/config`). Requires the `VM.Snapshot`, `VM.Snapshot.Rollback`, or `VM.Audit` privilege on `/vms/{vmid}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_container_snapshot" "pre_upgrade" {
  node = "pve1"
  vmid = 100
  name = "pre-upgrade"
}

output "snapshot_taken_at" {
  value = data.pve_container_snapshot.pre_upgrade.snaptime
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the snapshot (upstream `pve-configid`: at most 40 characters). The reserved name `current` refers to the live state and cannot be read here.
- `node` (String) The cluster node the container runs on.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the container. Must be between 100 and 999999999.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The textual description stored with the snapshot.
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier of the form `<node>/<vmid>/<name>`.
- `parent` (String) Name of the parent snapshot in the snapshot tree, when one exists.
- `snaptime` (Number) Unix epoch timestamp of when the snapshot was taken.
